rows.en:
I'm Nozomu Kazama.
I'm a third-year.
Well then, let me tell you my very best scary story.
The scariest of all the ghost stories passed down at this school.{p}
Ask if that's really the end
Stay quiet and see what happens

What's wrong?
Why is everybody so quiet?
My story's over, you know.{p}Why doesn't the next person go?
Ask if that's really the end
Move on to the next person's story
"...Um, it just feels kind of way too anticlimactic."{p}

"Can't be helped.
{f:All right then|For a cutie like you}, I'll tell you {f:one more|one more} of my very best.
{f:Don't fall over in shock on me, now|Try not to jump out of your skin, okay}."
Kazama glared around at everyone, cleared his throat once, and slowly went on.{p}

You all use the shoe lockers, right?
Of course you do.
Those shoe lockers.
Did you know there's a story that ghost lights appear there?
The end.{p}
Ask if that's really the end
Move on to the next person's story
Ask if that's really the end
Move on to the next person's story

A heavy silence fell over the club room.
Was that really the end of Kazama's story{f:?|?}
{f:I|I} asked him, uneasy.
"...Um.
Is that really the end?"
"Yeah, that's right.
I've gone and told three whole stories.
Wasn't the deal one story per person?
{f:You must be|...Don't tell me you} {f:satisfied by now, right?|want to hear more?}"
"...Well, {f:but|um,} {f:um,|you know,} how do I put it... {f:I'd like you to tell me something a bit more concrete.|I want to hear something a bit more concrete.}"{p}

She's a smart girl, with thin, upturned eyes.
Not very cute, though.
Maybe she's just too serious, but she never hangs out with anyone.
No matter who asks her, she never spends time with anybody.
Not guys, not girls, nobody.
She always goes straight home.
She's not in any club, either.
One day, you see, I happened to stumble onto her secret.
There was a reason she couldn't hang out with anyone.
Believe it or not, she was going to eight different cram schools.{p}
The end.{p}
Ask if that's really the end
Move on to the next person's story

"Yeah, it is.
A girl who goes to eight cram schools is scarier than any ghost, isn't she?
{f:Would you want to go out|Oh,} {f:with a girl like that?|but you're not that kind of girl, are you?}"
"...Um, let's leave aside whether it's scary in real life.
Couldn't you tell me a scary story that really fires up the imagination?"{p}

"...{f:Guess there's no helping it.|I see.}
You're dead set on making me tell a truly scary story, aren't you?
{f:All right.|Can't be helped.}
{f:Don't blame me for what happens.|Brace yourself before you listen...}"
It seemed to me that Kazama's face had gone a little pale.
And his body seemed to be trembling slightly.
Kazama began to speak, hesitantly.{p}...Truth is.
No, I really think I'd better not tell this one after all.
This is a distasteful story.
So distasteful, it might make you feel sick to hear it.
You've eaten at the school cafeteria, right?{p}That place's...
Wait a minute. I have a bad feeling about this
Listen to the story in silence
"Um, could you hold on a second?"{p}

"...What is it?
I was finally in the mood to tell it, so don't throw cold water on it, will you?"
"This wouldn't be a story about how the school cafeteria food tastes awful, would it?"
"...Oh, so you knew too?
That's right. That cafeteria's food is awful, isn't it?{p}

The only reason people eat there even though it's so awful is that it's cheap.
Just thinking about that set meal really fires up my imagination.
Ugh, I feel sick."
Maybe that was why Kazama had gone so pale.
What should I do?
Even if I let him keep going, I couldn't expect a scary story from this guy{f:.|.}{p}Should I just give up and pass the baton to the next person{f:?|?}
Try putting up with him one more time
Enough is enough. Hear the next person's story

The first person told one, so if I tell one more, the seven wonders will be complete.
Everyone, this is a mistake.
Making me tell the seventh story, of all things.
You don't understand what kind of calamity that will bring.
Frankly, the seventh story itself doesn't matter at all.
What matters is the fact that seven stories have been told.
Let's see, the seventh story...
Someone at this school killed themselves five years ago.
The end.
There. That does it.
Now the seven wonders are complete.
Do you know what happens when the seven wonders are finished?
One person disappears.{p}

That's right.
One of the people who were here suddenly vanishes, just like that.
Go on, count.
One... two... three... four... five... six.
...There are only six.
{c}{f:|}.
Including you, there ought to be seven of us, right?
But now there are six.
"...Kazama.
You're not counting yourself."{p}

Iwashita told one a little while ago, so if I tell one more, the seven wonders will be complete.
Do you all understand what's going to happen?{p}

I hate to say it, but this gathering is cursed.
Do you think what happened to Iwashita was a coincidence?
It was no coincidence.
It happened because it was bound to happen.
I knew it all along.
That if we kept going with the seven wonders like this, something terrible would happen.
None of us will get off lightly.
Especially you, {a}.
I'm afraid even to imagine what's going to happen to you.
...Well, even with me warning you like this, I suppose you'll keep going with the seven wonders anyway.{p}

Can you see it?
The evil spirit that's after us.
The evil spirit swirling in the corner of this room.
Look... over there!{p}

"Cut it out, Kazama... Huh?
Kazama? Kazama?"
...At some point, Kazama had vanished from the club room.
Everyone looked as if they'd been bewitched by a fox.{p}

There was no sign of anyone leaving the room.
I hadn't heard the door open, either.
Besides, it all happened in an instant.
A person just vanishing like that... it was unthinkable.
A chill ran down my spine.
Maybe this is what true terror really means.
I was too stunned to move.{p}

"What do we do?
I know things have turned out like this, but are we going to keep going?"
Someone's voice brought me back to my senses.
Something bad was definitely happening.
Should we really keep going like this?
Or would it be better to stop?
Continue
Stop

That's right.
It was nothing.
Just a string of coincidences, that's all.
I mean, that's just how Kazama is.
He set it all up from the start to scare us.
He must have been ready to slip away at a moment's notice.
That had to be it.
I pulled myself together and decided to carry on.
"Let's continue.
Now then, the third story is..."{p}
Ask him what he's getting at
Ask him to tell more about the statue
